title: Rye observed process transition assertion claim
description: Descriptive aggregate of evidenced process transitions in one closed window. Normalize process_key, from_state, and to_state for comparison with authoritative policy, while keeping the observed claim and key distinct. This claim never binds the promotion evaluator.

window_start.description: Inclusive start of the closed aggregation window.

window_end.description: Exclusive end of the closed aggregation window; must be later than window_start.

occurrence_count.description: Number of evidenced occurrences represented by this aggregate.

sample_event_ids.description: Optional examples only. Complete lineage is retained by the assertion source_event_id aggregation event or its artifact.
